import view

def test_basic_flow():
    """Test: begin -> finish with latest id -> success, older ids -> fail."""
    v = view.View()
    assert v.seq == 0
    assert v.error is None
    
    # First begin returns 1
    id1 = v.begin("query1")
    assert id1 == 1
    assert v.loading == False
    
    # Finish with latest id should succeed
    result = v.finish(id1, ["row1", "row2"])
    assert result == True
    assert v.rows == ["row1", "row2"]
    assert len(v._pending_ids) == 0
    
    # Another begin returns new id
    id2 = v.begin("query2")
    assert id2 == 2
    
    # Finish with old id should fail
    result = v.finish(id1, ["row3"])
    assert result == False
    assert v.rows == ["row1", "row2"]  # rows unchanged
    
    # Finish with latest id should succeed
    result = v.finish(id2, ["new", "rows"])
    assert result == True
    assert v.rows == ["new", "rows"]
    
def test_duplicate_finish():
    """Test: finishing same request twice returns False."""
    v = view.View()
    id1 = v.begin("q")
    result = v.finish(id1, ["r1"])
    assert result == True
    
    # Try to finish same id again
    result = v.finish(id1, ["r2"])
    assert result == False
    assert v.rows == ["r1"]

def test_begin_clears_errors():
    """Test: begin clears loading errors."""
    v = view.View()
    id1 = v.begin("q")
    # Error is cleared on begin (set internally)
    assert v.error is None

def test_finish_with_invalid_id():
    """Test: finish with never begun id returns False."""
    v = view.View()
    result = v.finish(999, ["row"])
    assert result == False
    
    # Finish with negative seq
    result = v.finish(-1, ["row"])
    assert result == False

def test_finish_requires_begun_id():
    """Test: finish requires a valid begun request."""
    v = view.View()
    id1 = v.begin("q1")
    
    # Start another request after first
    id2 = v.begin("q2")
    
    # Finish with older id should fail (id1)
    result = v.finish(id1, ["old"])
    assert result == False
    
    # Finish with newer id succeeds (id2)
    result = v.finish(id2, ["new"])
    assert result == True

def test_notes_persist():
    """Test: notes persist through requests."""
    v = view.View()
    v.notes["job1"] = "note for job 1"
    id1 = v.begin("q1")
    
    # Notes should persist
    assert v.notes["job1"] == "note for job 1"
    
    # Finish and new begin shouldn't clear notes from old keys
    result = v.finish(id1, ["rows"])
    assert result == True
    assert v.notes["job1"] == "note for job 1"

def test_rows_are_copied():
    """Test: rows passed to finish are copied."""
    v = view.View()
    orig_rows = [1, 2, 3]
    id1 = v.begin("q")
    result = v.finish(id1, orig_rows)
    assert result == True
    
    # Modify original list
    orig_rows.append(4)
    
    # View's rows should be unchanged (copied)
    assert v.rows == [1, 2, 3]

def test_loading_property():
    """Test: loading boolean exposed."""
    v = view.View()
    # Loading is False initially
    # After begin, it stays False (pending state cleared errors)
    id1 = v.begin("q")
    assert hasattr(v, 'loading')
    
def test_multiple_begins_then_finish_latest():
    """Test: multiple begins, only latest can be finished."""
    v = view.View()
    ids = [v.begin(f"q{i}") for i in range(5)]
    # Now finish with the last id
    result = v.finish(ids[-1], ["final"])
    assert result == True
    
    # Try to finish an old id - should fail
    for old_id in ids[:-1]:
        result = v.finish(old_id, ["stale"])
        assert result == False

    test_basic_flow()
    print("test_basic_flow passed")
    
    test_duplicate_finish()
    print("test_duplicate_finish passed")
    
    test_begin_clears_errors()
    print("test_begin_clears_errors passed")
    
    test_finish_with_invalid_id()
    print("test_finish_with_invalid_id passed")
    
    test_finish_requires_begun_id()
    print("test_finish_requires_begun_id passed")
    
    test_notes_persist()
    print("test_notes_persist passed")
    
    test_rows_are_copied()
    print("test_rows_are_copied passed")
    
    test_loading_property()
    print("test_loading_property passed")
    
    test_multiple_begins_then_finish_latest()
    print("test_multiple_begins_then_finish_latest passed")
    
    print("\nAll smoke tests passed!")
